description: Read the public Frantic board projection. Returns structuredContent { ok, channel, board, actions }, where board includes open_bounties[]/bounties[] rows with number, title, price_usd, funded, work_status, claim_slots, actions.claim.reason, and url, plus feed[] receipt events. Call frantic.get_bounty for required_artifacts before delivery.
name: frantic.read_board
title: Read Frantic board
